description: Sermons of Rabbi Gershon Leiner on Jewish holidays, published by his son, Rabbi Mordechai Yosef Elazar, and nephew, Rabbi Simcha Chaim. Complete Chasidut text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Hasidic literature gathers sermons, letters and teachings from the movement's dynasties and schools. Individual works are attributed to specific rebbes and schools rather than to Chasidut as a whole.
